coordinate_format: bbox_xywh in original-image pixel coordinates; no clipping, normalization or resizing applied
evaluation_scope: Small selected positive sanity fixture only; not formal mAP, independent test, field safety or complete 13-class evaluation.
crowd_policy: Preserve all iscrowd annotations; exclude crowd GT from FN, and ignore predictions overlapping crowd-only GT in the consuming device test.
excluded_categories_policy: GT for unmodeled COCO categories remains in source/coco-selected-original.json; gt.json contains all annotations from the seven mapped COCO categories.
